products.name: Clearscope
products.note: Content optimization AI; readability scoring; competitor content analysis

profile_text.body:
Clearscope is a content optimization platform that describes itself as "the discoverability platform for a new era in search," focused on helping brands improve their visibility in both traditional search engines and AI-generated results. The company's site states that its tools cover the full content workflow, from topic research and query discovery to AI-assisted drafting and ongoing optimization, with the goal of improving rankings in Google and citations in AI systems such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

The platform's Query Discovery feature allows users to research topics or website URLs to surface queries generating traffic and attention across Google and several major AI platforms. Clearscope also offers AI drafting and editing tools intended to accelerate content production and help users develop topical authority in their subject areas. The site includes testimonials from Ethan Smith, CEO at Graphite, and Eda Kavlakoğlu, describing the platform as useful for identifying emerging topics and competing for both low- and high-difficulty search terms.

The site's held facts list one tracked product under the Writing and Editing category, described as a content optimization AI with readability scoring and competitor content analysis. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
